title: Action note properties
description: The properties of an Action note in Matters that Matter: one unit of work, shown as one card on the board. The note's file name is the Action's title and its body holds the details and checklist. Only the mtm- properties listed here belong to an Action; any property without the mtm- prefix is allowed and left alone. A note needs only mtm-kind to be an Action, but a tool that creates one should also set mtm-type, mtm-status and mtm-matter, as the plugin does. Statuses and types are IDs from the plugin's settings (data.json; see settings.json), never labels. This schema describes what a tool should write; Matters that Matter reads more than it allows (older forms and values written by hand) and never rewrites them on its own. Later versions of the plugin may add mtm- properties; the file at this address is updated to list them, and a change that would refuse what was valid before gets a new address (v2).

mtm-kind.description: Marks the note as an Action. Notes are recognised by this property, never by their folder.

mtm-id.description: A stable identifier for the Action: a random UUID, written once when the note is created (or at its first write, for a note made before the key existed) and never changed, so a reference by ID survives a rename. Tools that create a note should write one; tools that edit a note keep it as it is.

mtm-type.description: The Action type's ID from settings (call, message, write and so on). It sets the card's colour and icon. When absent, the default type applies; an ID that is not in settings also falls back to the default type and shows a badge until it is fixed.

mtm-status.description: The status's ID from settings: the board column the Action sits in. When absent, the backlog status applies; an ID that is not in settings also falls back to it and shows a badge. Whether an Action is done is decided by the status's category (closed), not by its ID.

mtm-matter.description: The Matter the Action belongs to, as a link to the Matter note: a wikilink in quotes, such as "[[Kitchen renovation]]", in the shortest form that is unambiguous in the vault. When absent, the Action is in the Inbox; a link that does not lead to a Matter note also puts it in the Inbox, with a badge.

mtm-start.description: When work on the Action starts: YYYY-MM-DD for a whole day, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm for a time (24-hour clock, local time, no seconds or time zone). Optional. On its own it marks a single day on the calendar and the timeline. Matters that Matter also reads a time with seconds (which Obsidian's date picker writes) and a space before the time, but a tool should write one of these two forms.

mtm-due.description: When the Action is due: YYYY-MM-DD for a whole day, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm for a time (24-hour clock, local time, no seconds or time zone). Optional. A whole-day Action is overdue from the next day; a timed one once its time has passed. Done Actions are never overdue. Matters that Matter also reads a time with seconds (which Obsidian's date picker writes) and a space before the time, but a tool should write one of these two forms.

mtm-priority.description: 1 for high, 2 for medium, 3 for low. Leave it out for no priority.

mtm-waiting-on.description: The person the Action is waiting on, as a link to their note in quotes, such as "[[Marco Rossi]]". Whoever sets it also adds the same link to mtm-people and sets mtm-waiting-since to today; whoever removes it also removes mtm-waiting-since.

mtm-people.description: The people involved in the Action: a list of links to their notes, each in quotes. Always a list, even with one person.

mtm-waiting-since.description: The day mtm-waiting-on was set or last changed to another person, as YYYY-MM-DD. Set it to today when you set or change mtm-waiting-on, and remove it when you remove mtm-waiting-on. Never fill it in for older Actions that lack it. The plugin ignores it while mtm-waiting-on is absent.

mtm-completed.description: The day the Action was done, as YYYY-MM-DD. Set it to today when the Action moves from a status that is not closed into a closed one, if it is not already set; remove it when the Action moves out of a closed status. Moving between two closed statuses leaves it as it is. Never fill it in for done Actions that lack it.

mtm-order.description: The Action's position within its board cell, lower first, on boards and lists ordered by hand. Written by Matters that Matter; other tools never need to set it, and should remove it when they move the Action to another status or Matter, as the plugin does.

mtm-sample.description: Marks the note as sample content, so that "Remove sample content" can find it. Other tools should not set it.

date.description: A real calendar day, as YYYY-MM-DD.

dateOrDateTime.description: A real calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, or a day and time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm.

link.description: A wikilink to a note, such as [[Note name]], [[Folder/Note name]] or [[Note name|shown text]], with an optional #heading. Written in quotes in the note's properties, because YAML reads an unquoted [[…]] as a list.
